text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ――Well then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you for taking the time to meet for our final strategy session ahead of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text:
"After bowing respectfully to each other and looking up,
they spread out the printed materials."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The venue is Kyoto Racecourse, which is somewhat familiar territory for us. ...In that case,
our course strategy will be just as we discussed previously.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Basically, this course tends to result in a rather slow-paced race, so—
choice_data_list: It tends to come down to a battle of finishing speed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, in the 'Training_Schedule_v131' update,
I prioritized menus focused on boosting dash power, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Looking at "Skill Chart Analysis_103",
I believe we are making steady progress.
choice_data_list: Good. Everything's going according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to you.
...And so—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've finished our review,
shall we move on to today's most important agenda item?

As she spoke, Air Messiah picked up
'Rival Data Analysis_166.'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The contenders for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup have finally been confirmed.
choice_data_list: Yeah. The one to really watch is—
Yeah. The one to watch out for in particular is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...First, naturally,
would be Sweep Tosho-san."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It seems you took some time off to recover from an injury
after last year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
She displayed overwhelming strength in her comeback Graded race
and secured victory. We must assume that her wildly unorthodox running
is still very much alive and well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Boasting a sharp burst of speed that can only be called magical
and miraculous, her closing kick could pose a serious threat
in a final test of instantaneous power.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...However, in addition to that.
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...The next generation is muscling their way in too, huh?
Yeah. ...The next generation has really stepped into the fray, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Challengers from the Classic division—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Most notably, Kawakami Princess,
who conquered the Oaks and Shuka Sho
undefeated from her debut.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: In the world of competition, "momentum" seems to be an unexpectedly non-negligible factor.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Following a late debut, she breezed through the ranks,
and in just four races reigned supreme
as a GⅠ champion—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, Kawakami-san is currently
the Umamusume with the absolute most momentum.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And—that should just about cover it.
After that... Air Messiah neatly stacked the documents, straightened her posture, and turned back to face me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Then let us refine things further.
Analyzing the current situation and constructing countermeasures.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Steadily. Surely.
Step by step."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let us take our steps toward victory.

Air Messiah and I keep building.
Putting in honest, proper effort, one day at a time.

"Believing that within it lies
an unchanging, steadfast strength."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The start is finally approaching for
today's main race, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Splendid maidens, each shining with equal brilliance.
Which Umamusume will seize the glory of becoming the Queen of Autumn?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Haa...!
The race is finally, finally here...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
I'll... watch without even blinking!
Messiah-san...
I believe in your victory...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Did you
come to cheer for Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whoa!?
A-A-Are you... could you be...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Stop throwing a tantrum and get over here!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Who's throwing a tantrum, huh?!
I'm just saying I can see it just fine from here!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You really are a stubborn one who can't just be honest with yourself. Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine, then I shall say it like this:
This is an 'Order from the Student Council Vice President.'
Accompany me to the stands by the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's your important junior's race.
Go praise her from a spot where she can see you clearly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my!
Shakur and everyone.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Heading toward the finish line? Fufu, would you mind if we joined you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes, please!
Um, I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... In that case, allow me to lead the way.
Please follow me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Breathe in--

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Stop it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Thank you very much for joining me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...A common mindset people have before the real race
is to think, 'I'll show the results of my training,'
right?
choice_data_list: Yeah... I think about that pretty often too.
Yeah... I might think about that a lot too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, I find that things rarely
go the way we think they will.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is quite common for someone to effortlessly succeed in practice,
yet fail spectacularly in the actual race as if by some cruel twist of fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the actual "results" one can produce...
are only about one-third of the "practice"
one has accumulated?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "I wouldn't say I'm someone who thrives under pressure, so it might turn out even worse than that."
choice_data_list: ...Still, the way you 'practice' is truly incredible.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I have built this up alongside you.
Even if it is shaved down to a third, to a tenth—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"My footing will never falter.
I have built up the strength to ensure that."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer,
I shall be off.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'll go show them the fruits of my training.
